health.title: My Health
health.info_content: For the most accurate results, you should measure at the same time each day (usually in the morning when you wake up) and use the same measuring device.
health.weight_info_content: Regular weight monitoring is key to understanding your body. The best time to weigh yourself is in the morning after waking up and before breakfast.
health.height_info_content: Regular height monitoring helps you understand your body's growth process. The best time to measure is in the morning, after waking up and before starting daily activities.
health.bmi_analysis_subtitle: Review your average Body Mass Index (BMI).

bmi_info.title: BMI
bmi_info.description:
The Body Mass Index (BMI) is calculated by dividing your weight (in kg) by the square of your height (in meters).

It is a quick health assessment tool that helps determine if a person is at a weight appropriate for their height.
bmi_info.underweight_desc: Your body needs more nutrients. Please consult a nutritionist for an appropriate diet.
bmi_info.normal_desc: Congratulations! You have an ideal weight. Keep maintaining a healthy lifestyle and a balanced diet.
bmi_info.overweight_desc: You should pay attention to weight control through increased physical activity and daily menu adjustments.
bmi_info.obese_desc: This condition can increase the risk of chronic diseases. You should seek professional advice for a safe weight loss plan.
bmi_info.note_content: BMI does not accurately reflect muscle mass, bone density, or body fat distribution. For example, athletes may have a high BMI due to high muscle mass but still be very healthy.
